usdRate.sourceName: Bank of Algeria, daily exchange rate quotation of 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: Bank of Algeria quotation of the dinar against the US dollar for 30 October 2026. The verifier could not open the Bank of Algeria page (TLS certificate error), but Trading Economics showed USD/DZD at 135.79 on 3 November 2026, which agrees with it. World Bank 2025 average: 131.61. CLDR gives no narrow symbol; 'DA' is how prices are written locally.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Office National des Statistiques (ONS), national CPI August 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Annual inflation rose to 8.01% in August 2026 from 6.73% in July. This is a secondary source because the ONS site could not be opened (TLS certificate error). The verifier replaced an unconfirmed ONS Algiers figure of 8.3%. World Bank 2025 average 1.4%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025 (about 6% average); ONS 12-month average 3.9% to August 2026
inflation_projection.note: The Bank of Algeria publishes no numeric inflation target, so a rounded 5% is used: below the 2021-2025 average of about 6% and the 8.0% reading of August 2026, but above the 1.4% of 2025.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Bank of Algeria benchmark (discount) rate
policy_rate.note: 2.50%, at a record low since January 2026 and unchanged at the latest reading (reference September 2026); secondary source because the Bank of Algeria site loads its rate tables by script.

savings_account_rate.note: No official or industry-wide rate for ordinary savings books (livret d'épargne) was found; web search was unavailable for part of this research.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published rate for 3-month term deposits was found; the Bank of Algeria statistics pages could not be read.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published rate for 1-year term deposits was found; the Bank of Algeria statistics pages could not be read.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Algeria
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 1.75% for 2025 (IMF IFS series via the World Bank); no fresher Bank of Algeria figure could be read.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No current government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; the Treasury has run one-off national bond issues in the past.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Treasury bill (BTC) auction results are published by the Ministry of Finance, whose site could not be reached.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Treasury bond (OAT) yield could be read; the Ministry of Finance site could not be reached.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Treasury bond yield could be read; the Ministry of Finance site could not be reached.

tax_bank_interest.note: The withholding rate on bank and savings interest in the Code des impôts directs could not be read from an official or PwC page (PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Algeria page).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found, and the tax rate on Treasury securities income could not be confirmed.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A deposit guarantee fund exists (Société de Garantie des Dépôts Bancaires), but the current cover per depositor could not be read from the Bank of Algeria regulations.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical rate for credit card balances was found; card payments are mostly debit (CIB/Edahabia).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Algeria / World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; very small Algiers Stock Exchange
equity_return_low.note: The Algiers Stock Exchange lists only a handful of companies with little trading, so the low case is close to zero in local currency.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75% (2025); inflation assumption 5%
equity_return_base.note: Kept within 4 points of the after-tax safe rate (about 1.5%) and below that cap, because the local market is tiny and has no long, liquid index record.

equity_return_high.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; inflation assumption 5%
equity_return_high.note: High case: equities beat inflation by about 3 points a year.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Bank of Algeria exchange rate (about 4.5% dinar fall against the dollar over the past year)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with slow dinar depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Bank of Algeria exchange rate; long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold trend of about 4% plus about 2% a year of dinar depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Bank of Algeria exchange rate; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold and faster dinar depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings rates below the average deposit rate, after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the average deposit rate less roughly 10% withholding tax (rate not confirmed), so about 1.5%.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; policy rate 2.5%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits and Treasury paper at around the policy rate or a little above.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found from the insurance supervisor (Commission de Supervision des Assurances).

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Death-cover (temporaire décès) insurance is sold, mostly with loans, but no published premium rates per DZD 1,000 of cover by age were found from a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Algeria
oop_health_share.note: 45.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Trading Economics CPI (8.0% in August 2026); World Bank CPI 2021-2025; inflation assumption 5%
goal_inflation_health.note: Private care costs usually outpace general prices, so 1 point above the 5% inflation assumption is used; no health CPI series could be read.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Trading Economics CPI (8.0% in August 2026); World Bank CPI 2021-2025; inflation assumption 5%
goal_inflation_education.note: Public education is free and no education CPI series could be read, so education costs are planned at the general 5% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Algeria

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 10.76 (2025, World Bank), 17.5 (2040) and 31.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/algeria/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Law No. 16-15 of 31 December 2016 amending Law No. 83-12 on retirement (Journal officiel No. 78, 2016)
retirement_age_default.note: Law 16-15 (Art. 6 of Law 83-12 as amended) sets the pension age at 60 with at least 15 years of work; women may retire from 55 at their request. Retirement without an age condition ended on 1 January 2019. The law is older than 2025 but still in force, and it applies to anyone born after 1975.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Law No. 16-15 amending Law No. 83-12 on retirement (Journal officiel No. 78, 2016)
retirement_age_government.note: Law No. 83-12 covers all salaried workers including public employees, so civil servants also retire at 60 (women from 55 on request); older than 2025 but still in force.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings-book rates after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: the average deposit rate after roughly 10% withholding tax; not above the after-tax safe rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; policy rate 2.5%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: term deposits and Treasury paper near the policy rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; tiny local equity market
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; equity base 4%; gold base 6%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, gold and some equity, below inflation-plus because local markets are shallow.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.75%; equity high 8%; gold high 10%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: A means-tested flat solidarity allowance (Allocation forfaitaire de solidarité) for older people without income exists, but its current amount could not be read from an official source.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility rules of the solidarity allowance (Allocation forfaitaire de solidarité) could not be read from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service or retirement gratuity for private employees was confirmed; Law No. 90-11 on labour relations and collective agreements could not be checked.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Law No. 16-15 of 31 December 2016 amending Law No. 83-12 on retirement
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory pay-as-you-go pension for salaried workers, run by the Caisse Nationale des Retraites (CNR). Under Law 16-15 (Art. 6 of Law 83-12 as amended), the pension starts at 60 after at least 15 years of work; women may retire from 55 at their request. Law 16-15 abolished retirement without an age condition from 2019. The law contains no automatic price-indexation rule, so inflationLinked is false (conservative); tax treatment was not checked. The law is older than 2025 but still in force.

savings_account.note: Savings books are offered by banks and the postal network; rates are low.

fdr_1y.note: Banks also sell short-term bank bonds (bons de caisse).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No continuously sold government savings certificate; the Treasury has issued occasional national bonds to the public.

tbill_91d.note: Sold at auction mainly to banks and other institutions; access for individuals is limited.

tbond_5y.note: Issued at auction, mainly held by banks and insurers.

tbond_10y.note: Issued at auction, mainly held by banks and insurers.

equity_fund.note: No diversified equity or index fund sold to retail investors was found. The Algiers Stock Exchange, supervised by COSOB, lists only a few companies. This was not confirmed by a source saying none exists.

gold.note: Gold is bought mostly as jewellery; availability of investment bars and coins was not confirmed.

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Supervision Commission (Commission de Supervision des Assurances), Ministry of Finance

pensionScheme.name: National Pension Fund (Caisse Nationale des Retraites, CNR)

publicHealthCover.name: National Social Insurance Fund for Salaried Workers (CNAS); public hospitals give free care

depositInsurance.name: Bank Deposit Guarantee Company (Société de Garantie des Dépôts Bancaires), under the Bank of Algeria

statistics.name: National Statistics Office (Office National des Statistiques, ONS)
